heroOnTransparent: Combining {n} links for the whole PC (transparent mode)
heroOnProxy: Combining {n} links for apps using the Windows proxy
heroOffSub: Windows uses its normal connection. Press the button to combine your links.
oneLinkWarn: Only one link is connected, so there is nothing to combine. If Wi‑Fi drops when the phone is plugged in over USB, turn on “Keep Wi‑Fi with USB tethering” in Settings.
dlLead: Downloads one file over all links at once: their speeds add up.
historyLead: Data received through each link, per day.
settingsLead: How dualnet captures traffic, and the Windows settings that help it.
tunOn: Captures all the PC’s IPv4 traffic (Steam, games, browser…) with a virtual network adapter.
tunOff: Off. Captures all the PC’s traffic with a virtual network adapter, no app settings needed.
tunNeedAdmin: Needs dualnet to run as administrator.
sysOurs: On: apps that follow the Windows proxy (Edge, Chrome…) go through dualnet.
sysOther: Another proxy is set ({s}); turning this on replaces it until dualnet closes.
sysOff: Off. Points the Windows proxy to dualnet; restored when dualnet closes.
howBrowser: Firefox: Settings → Network → Manual proxy → SOCKS v5, tick “Proxy DNS when using SOCKS”.
simOn: Windows keeps Wi‑Fi connected when the phone is plugged in.
simOff: By default Windows drops Wi‑Fi as soon as a wired connection (USB tethering) appears.
needAdmin: Needs dualnet to run as administrator.
preferSub: For traffic that does not go through dualnet.
steamSub: So Steam reopens its connections through dualnet.
autoSub: Opens dualnet in the notification area when you sign in, without a UAC prompt.
appsNeedTun: Per-application statistics and rules need transparent mode (run dualnet as administrator and turn it on).
rulesHead: Restrict an application to one link
rulesSub: Example: keep an online game on Wi‑Fi for a steady ping while Steam uses every link. If the chosen link is down, the application uses the others. Transparent mode only.
budgetPrompt: Monthly data budget for {n} in GB (0 = none). Counts the data that goes through dualnet on this link; when it is used up, dualnet stops sending it new connections until next month.
notifSub: A Windows notification when a link drops, comes back or appears, even if this window is closed.
diagSub: Version, links and the latest log lines. Check it before sharing publicly: it lists your network interface names and addresses.
updSub: Asks GitHub for the latest release once a day. Nothing is downloaded or installed automatically.
